steps.text: Open https://site.ludus-game.com/ and wait until the page has finished loading.
If a "How we use cookies" banner is shown, click "Dismiss".
steps.saw: Banner shown, clicked Dismiss, banner gone

steps.text: Scroll down to the "Latest news" section.
steps.saw: Latest news section with one card visible

steps.text: Read the date on the first news card (for example "October 15").
Scroll down to the footer and choose "Français" in the "EN" language selector.
Scroll down to the "Dernières infos" section.
steps.saw: Dernières infos section visible with the same card

steps.text: Is the date on the same news card the same day and month as in English?
steps.saw: French card shows "10 mars" (10 March), title "La version 1.38 est disponible !"; English card showed "October 15"
Selected English; address back to https://site.ludus-game.com/
